presets.name: Quick Health Check
presets.description: Fast read-only checks suitable before installing the development suite.

presets.name: Deep Diagnostics
presets.description: Thorough read-only diagnostics focused on Windows integrity and hardware health. Some checks can take a long time.

presets.name: All Diagnostics
presets.description: Runs every read-only Windows Care diagnostic. Long-running checks are included; no repair action is executed.

actions.name: Disk space analysis
actions.description: Measures safe cleanup candidates and large Windows-maintenance caches without deleting anything.

actions.name: Pending restart check
actions.description: Detects servicing, update and pending file rename restart markers.

actions.name: Windows Installer health
actions.description: Checks Windows Installer service state, executable version and in-progress transaction markers without starting or repairing the service.

actions.name: Windows time health
actions.description: Checks time service and synchronization state because clock problems can break TLS, sign-in and certificate validation.

actions.name: Volume Shadow Copy health
actions.description: Lists VSS writers and existing shadow copies. It never deletes or resizes shadow storage.

actions.name: Windows runtime & recovery readiness
actions.description: Inventories legacy .NET readiness plus WinRE, BitLocker, TPM and Secure Boot servicing state without changing recovery, encryption, firmware or optional Windows features.

actions.name: Development environment readiness
actions.description: Reports PATH duplication, PowerShell policy/language mode, application-control state, proxy settings and conflicting Python commands without changing them.

actions.name: Windows component store analysis
actions.description: Runs DISM AnalyzeComponentStore. Does not delete WinSxS files.

actions.name: DISM quick component-store health
actions.description: Checks whether Windows has already marked the component store as corrupted.

actions.name: DISM deep component-store scan
actions.description: Performs a full corruption scan. Can take significant time.

actions.name: System File Checker verify-only
actions.description: Verifies protected Windows files without repairing or replacing them.

actions.name: Online file-system scan
actions.description: Runs CHKDSK /scan on the Windows volume without scheduling an offline repair.

actions.name: Physical storage health
actions.description: Reads disk health, wear, temperature and reliability counters where supported.

actions.name: Device and driver problem scan
actions.description: Enumerates present devices reporting Windows Plug and Play problems. Does not update drivers.

actions.name: Recent critical Windows events
actions.description: Summarizes recent critical and error events from System and Application logs.

actions.name: Windows Update health
actions.description: Checks update services, cache size, pending restart state and recent update-related errors.

actions.name: Power and battery diagnostics
actions.description: Generates Windows power efficiency and battery reports when applicable.

actions.name: Clean stale temporary files
actions.description: Deletes only old, unlocked files under approved temporary folders. User documents and downloads are never touched.

actions.name: Clear Delivery Optimization cache
actions.description: Uses the Windows Delivery Optimization cmdlet and preserves pinned content by default.

actions.name: Safe Windows component cleanup
actions.description: Runs DISM StartComponentCleanup. ResetBase is deliberately forbidden.

actions.name: Repair Windows image from verified local source
actions.description: Runs DISM RestoreHealth only when a locally bundled repair source matches Windows build/revision, architecture and language metadata; Windows Update is not contacted.

actions.name: Repair protected Windows system files
actions.description: Runs SFC /scannow after component-store health is suitable.

actions.name: Rebuild Windows Update working cache
actions.description: Stops update services and renames SoftwareDistribution/Catroot2 to timestamped backups, then restarts services. Nothing is immediately deleted.
